search_text: published ZDI-21-1305 ZDI-CAN-14223 Adobe RoboHelp Server Directory Traversal Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2021-11-11 CVE-2021-42727 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2021-42727 8.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Adobe'] ['RoboHelp Server'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Adobe RoboHelp Server. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the RoboHelp server. When parsing the fileName parameter, the process does not properly validate a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of SYSTEM. Adobe has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
